mastery_task.scenario_en: You check a fictional member card before a class.
mastery_task.scenario_ar: تراجع بطاقة عضو خيالية قبل محاضرة.
mastery_task.prompt_en: Find the requested first name, last name, nationality, address, and phone number.
mastery_task.support: Requested field labels only; no highlighting or answer-bearing translation.
mastery_task.freshness: The layout, person, values, and field order differ from practice.

replacement_mastery_task.scenario_en: You locate details in a fictional volunteer profile written as short prose.
replacement_mastery_task.scenario_ar: تبحث عن بيانات في نبذة قصيرة لمتطوع خيالي.
replacement_mastery_task.prompt_en: Retrieve the same five detail types from the changed layout.
replacement_mastery_task.support: Requested field labels only; no highlighting or answer-bearing translation.
replacement_mastery_task.freshness: A prose layout and new values test location rather than table memorisation.

rubric.level_2: Each requested label is understood as the intended detail type.
All five values are located and copied accurately.
The learner succeeds in a new layout without fixed-position cues.
A field-value mismatch is detected and corrected.

decision.demonstrated: Level 2 or above on every required dimension.
decision.needs_review: Any required dimension below level 2; use targeted practice and a new task.
decision.completion_rule: Opening sections or finishing exercises never grants mastery.

teach_back_variant.prompt_ar: اشرح ليه قيمة صحيحة من سطر غلط تعتبر إجابة غير صحيحة.

omit_variant.content: Proceed directly to the matched close and review card.

delayed_review.task: Find three details in a new card.
Separate first and last name in a changed profile.
Retrieve five details from a prose layout.
